name: GDR Windows
description: Exposes window enumeration, window actions and window open/close events to gdrd over the session bus (org.gdr.Windows). GNOME 50 refuses org.gnome.Shell.Introspect.GetWindows to unprivileged callers, so a shell extension is the only sanctioned way for a daemon to see the window list. Does nothing on its own — gdrd must be running and authenticated for anything to reach this.
